stem: Which of the following provides evidence to support President Obama's assertion that “America became more free and more fair”?

options.label: A
options.text: The passage of the Civil Rights Act of 1964

options.label: B
options.text: The ratification of the Eighteenth Amendment

options.label: C
options.text: The passage of the USA PATRIOT Act

options.label: D
options.text: The establishment of the Socialist Party

visual_elements: Because they marched, America became more free and more fair—not just for African Americans, but for women and Latinos, Asians and Native Americans; . . . for Americans with a disability. America changed for you and for me. And the entire world drew strength from that example. . . . —President Barack Obama, speech at the “Let Freedom Ring” ceremony commemorating the 50th anniversary of the March on Washington, August 28, 2013
